description: A painted still life of a bathroom shelf in warm, dim light. An open silver case with a round mirror and a small test tube in a stand sits at the centre, with a glass dropper lying across the shelf and a small glass vial at the left edge. Behind it an open cardboard box with cut compartments, a tiled wall and a patterned wallpaper panel, and a roll of tissue on the floor at the bottom. No people, no visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
